summary: Horizon Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a quarterly dividend of $0.16 per share, payable on July 17, 2026 to holders of record on July 3, 2026. This is a routine capital return event via ordinary dividend; no special situation or event-driven corporate transaction is present. The Board approved this as part of ongoing dividend policy. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or deal termination elements. The filing is a standard current report with no special-situation trigger. Stockholders should monitor future filings for any material changes in dividend plans.
